name: ZX_FORMULA_B
description: This table stores tax formulas that will be used to calculate taxable basis and tax amounts. Each row stores a formula to determine taxable basis or tax amount for a specific tax.

columns.name: FORMULA_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code that indicates whether this formula is for calculation of taxable basis or tax amount

columns.name: FORMULA_CODE
columns.description: Formula code

columns.name: TAX_REGIME_CODE
columns.description: Tax regime code for which this formula is applicable

columns.name: TAX
columns.description: Tax for which this formula is applicable

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Effective from date

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Effective to date

columns.name: ENABLED_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether this formula is enabled

columns.name: TAXABLE_BASIS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Column to store whether the transaction line amount, the prior tax amount or the quantity is to be treated as the taxable basis. Possible values are LINE AMOUNT, PRIOR TAX and QUANTITY.

columns.name: RECORD_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Lookup code to indicate whether the record is migrated, seeded or defined by the user

columns.name: BASE_RATE_MODIFIER
columns.description: Base rate modifier percentage for taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: CASH_DISCOUNT_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether cash discount is applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: VOLUME_DISCOUNT_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether volume discount is applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: TRADING_DISCOUNT_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether trading discount is applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: TRANSFER_CHARGE_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether transfer charge is applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: TRANSPORT_CHARGE_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether transportation charge is applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: INSURANCE_CHARGE_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether insurance charge is applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: OTHER_CHARGE_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Y or N indicates whether other charges are applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: REQUEST_ID
columns.description: Enterprise Service Scheduler: indicates the request ID of the job that created or last updated the row.

columns.name: PROGRAM_LOGIN_ID
columns.description: Login user identifier of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.description: Unique identifier

columns.description: Party tax profile identifier for configuration owner of this formula

columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PROGRAM_NAME
columns.description: Program name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PROGRAM_APP_NAME
columns.description: Application name of last concurrent program to update this record

columns.name: PACKING_CHARGE_APPL_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether packing charge is applicable for determining taxable basis of type LINE AMOUNT. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: APPLY_UNIT_PRC_THRSHLD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if unit price threshold is applied for the formula. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: APPLY_TXBS_VAL_ADD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if taxable basis value addition is applied for the formula. Valid values: Y and N.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET1
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET1. Context values are Y or N.

columns.name: ORA_SEED_SET2
columns.description: Oracle internal use only. Indicates the edition-based redefinition (EBR) context of the row for SET2. Context values are Y or N.
